item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Bank of America hit with $1.2B money-laundering penalty
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

U.S. regulators fined Bank of America $1.21 billion, saying it failed to report more than $5 billion in suspicious activity, including transactions tied to national-security and sanctions risks. The penalty will cut third-quarter earnings and signals tougher enforcement against large-bank compliance failures. [1] [2]

Sources: [1] [2]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News
